research_summary: Comprehensive backorder platform audit covering 8 platforms. Key finding: NameJet and SnapNames share identical inventory since 2020 — use only ONE of them per domain to avoid bidding against yourself. Park.io does NOT cover .com or .org (ccTLDs only). Namecheap does NOT offer backorders. Porkbun does NOT offer backorders (uses Dynadot DAX for expired auctions). GoDaddy discontinued backorders in Oct 2025 — auction-only now.

platforms.name: DropCatch

verification_requirements.summary: DropCatch requires identity verification before auction participation
methods: Government-issued photo ID (passport or driver's license) — high-quality color scan/photo
Valid credit card added to DropCatch or NameBright account
Credit card deposit may be required
verification_requirements.when_required: Required for all auction participation. May be re-triggered for high-value bids or suspicious activity.
verification_requirements.action_needed: Complete ID verification by uploading government ID + selfie. This is the Sprint 10 blocker that must be resolved FIRST.

signup_steps: 1. Go to https://www.dropcatch.com/Registration
2. Create account with email and password (DONE — account exists)
3. Verify email address via confirmation link
4. Navigate to Account Settings > Verification
5. Upload government-issued photo ID (passport or driver's license)
6. Take and upload a selfie holding the same ID
7. Add a valid credit card to your account
8. Wait for manual review (typically 1-3 business days)
9. Once verified, navigate to the backorder search page
10. Search for each target domain and click 'Backorder'

cost_structure.discount_club_backorder: $10-$58 per domain (lower priority — HugeDomains gets first pick)
cost_structure.if_caught_contested: Goes to PUBLIC 3-day auction — highest bidder wins
cost_structure.recommendation: USE STANDARD $59 BACKORDERS for priority domains. Discount club is deprioritized behind corporate partners like HugeDomains.

platforms.success_rate: Industry-leading catch rate. Operates 1,200+ registrar accreditations for drop-catching. Highest volume catcher for .com domains.
strengths: Largest drop-catching infrastructure (1,200+ registrars)
Best catch rate for .com domains
Public auction means you can still win even if others backordered
No charge if domain not caught
weaknesses: Discount Club backorders are deprioritized behind corporate partners
Public auctions can drive prices up quickly

estimated_cost_9_domains.backorder_placement: $59 x 6 domains = $354 (only placing on 6 — see matrix)

platforms.name: SnapNames
platforms.critical_note: SnapNames and NameJet share IDENTICAL inventory since 2020. Placing backorders on BOTH platforms for the same domain means BIDDING AGAINST YOURSELF. Choose ONE platform per domain.
signup_steps: 1. Go to https://www.snapnames.com/registration.action
2. Fill in: username, email, password, name, address
3. Verify email via confirmation link
4. Log in and add payment method (credit card)
5. Search for target domain in the backorder search
6. Click 'Backorder' on each target domain
7. Set your backorder amount (minimum $79)
8. Confirm checkout — no charge until domain is caught

cost_structure.if_caught_multiple_backorders: Private 3-day auction among all who backordered. Only backorder holders can bid.
cost_structure.note: Your backorder amount is NOT a proxy bid. It's the starting price you'd pay if uncontested.

platforms.success_rate: Moderate. Shares catch infrastructure with NameJet. Together they are the #2 catching service behind DropCatch.
strengths: 200+ TLDs supported including .org
Private auctions (only backorder holders can bid — less competition)
No charge if not caught
Chronological priority if multiple backorders but no auction bids
weaknesses: Shares inventory with NameJet — do NOT use both
Lower catch rate than DropCatch for .com

estimated_cost_9_domains.if_auctions_occur: Variable — private auction among backorder holders

platforms.name: NameJet
platforms.critical_note: NameJet and SnapNames share IDENTICAL inventory since 2020. USE ONLY ONE of these two platforms per domain. Bidding on both = bidding against yourself.
signup_steps: 1. Go to https://www.namejet.com/registration.action
2. Create account with email, username, password
3. Verify email address
4. Add payment method (credit card)
5. Search for target domain
6. Click 'Place Backorder' or 'Pre-Bid'
7. Enter your backorder amount (minimum $79 for pending delete)
8. Confirm — no charge until caught

cost_structure.if_caught_multiple_backorders: Private auction among backorder holders only
cost_structure.registration_included: Yes — domain registration fee is included in your winning bid. You pay what you bid, nothing more.

pre_release_vs_drop_catch.pre_release: Domain listed by registrar before it actually drops. Auction happens while domain is still in redemption/grace. Registrar can pull domain from auction if owner renews.
pre_release_vs_drop_catch.pending_delete: Domain has passed all grace periods and is in the 5-day pending delete phase. This is the true 'drop catch' — domain will be deleted and re-registered.

platforms.success_rate: Moderate-High. Same catch infrastructure as SnapNames. Strong for pre-release domains from partner registrars.
strengths: Pre-release access to domains from partner registrars (Bluehost, HostGator, etc.)
Registration included in bid price
Private auctions reduce competition
Backorder is NOT a proxy bid — transparent pricing
weaknesses: Shares inventory with SnapNames — do NOT use both
Pre-release domains can be pulled if owner renews

platforms.name: Dynadot
signup_steps: 1. Go to https://www.dynadot.com/account/create
2. Enter email, create password, fill in contact details
3. Verify email via confirmation link
4. Log in and add $5 minimum to account balance (or make any $5+ purchase)
5. Navigate to https://www.dynadot.com/market/backorder
6. Search for each target domain
7. Click 'Backorder' and confirm
8. No charge until domain is successfully caught

cost_structure.if_caught_multiple_backorders: Private 3-day auction among backorder holders. Starting bid = backorder price of first requester.

platforms.name: GoDaddy Auctions
platforms.critical_note: GoDaddy DISCONTINUED backorder service in October 2025. They now only offer expired domain AUCTIONS (no pre-placement backorders). You cannot 'backorder' a domain on GoDaddy anymore — you must watch for it to appear in their auction pipeline and bid manually.
signup_steps: 1. Go to https://auctions.godaddy.com
2. Create a GoDaddy account (or log in if you have one)
3. Purchase GoDaddy Auctions membership ($4.99/year)
4. Add payment method for bidding
5. Set up Watchlist alerts for target domains (if they are GoDaddy-registered)
6. Monitor the Expired Auctions section daily for target domains
7. Bid when domains appear in auction

expired_auction.description: Domains expired at GoDaddy enter auction 26 days after expiration

closeout.description: Domains with no bids after 10-day auction enter 5-day closeout (reverse/Dutch auction)

cost_structure.alerts: Yes — you can set up domain watchlist/alerts, but only for domains registered at GoDaddy

strengths: Cheapest membership fee ($4.99/year)

Watchlist alerts
weaknesses: Cannot pre-place backorders — must monitor and bid manually

what_happens_when_multiple_platforms_cat.scenario: You placed backorders on DropCatch + SnapNames + Dynadot for the same domain
what_happens_when_multiple_platforms_cat.outcome: Only ONE platform actually catches the domain (the one whose registrar accreditation wins the race at the registry). You only pay the platform that catches it.
what_happens_when_multiple_platforms_cat.you_pay: Only the winning platform. Other platforms charge $0.
what_happens_when_multiple_platforms_cat.no_double_payment: Correct — you never pay two platforms for the same domain.

what_happens_within_one_platform.scenario: Multiple USERS backordered the same domain on DropCatch
what_happens_within_one_platform.outcome: Domain goes to auction. DropCatch: public 3-day auction. SnapNames/NameJet: private auction (backorder holders only). Dynadot: private 3-day auction.

average_catch_rate.for_niche_domains: Higher — less competition on niche terms like sushifaq.com
average_catch_rate.for_generic_domains: Lower — codeguide.com will face heavy competition

maximize_catch_probability: 1. Place backorders on ALL 3 platforms (DropCatch + SnapNames + Dynadot) for every domain
2. Use STANDARD priority on DropCatch ($59) — NOT discount club
3. Place backorders as early as possible — some platforms give chronological priority
4. Monitor GoDaddy Auctions and Namecheap Auctions for domains registered at those registrars
5. Set max auction bids BEFORE auctions start — don't get caught up in bidding wars
6. For globalgeopark.org and fitocracy.com (highest value), consider raising max bids
